text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before Admire Vega's Hopeful Stakes, 
Narita Top Road had suffered a narrow 
defeat in her own debut race despite being 
the heavy favorite.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She almost let slip a question to Admire 
Vega, who had proudly taken first place in 
the preliminary popularity poll, asking if 
she ever felt frightened by such high 
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega explains, however, that as 
long as you have the resolve to see 
through what you decided—no matter what 
happens—your legs will never stop.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Carrying heavy resolve in her heart... 
Admire Vega headed for the Hopeful Stakes.
